newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU offers sympathy to Tel Aviv victims, urges peace.
newsitem.headline: EU offers sympathy to Tel Aviv victims, urges peace.

text.p: The Dutch presidency of the European Union on Friday extended its condolences to those hurt and killed in the Tel Aviv bombing and said it hoped the atack would not derail the Middle East peace process.
"We express our deepest sympathy to the victims and their families," Dutch prime minister Wim Kok told a news conference after the weekly cabinet meeting.
"As president of the European Union it is our heartfelt hope that all those involved will continue their efforts to reach a peaceful solution for the problems in the Middle East."
The European Union would be happy to offer its services in seeking a solution, Kok added.
Two people were killed and 43 wounded in the attack by a Palestinian Moslem suicide bomber on a crowded Tel Aviv cafe at Friday lunchtime.
